prompts.title: Impasto Reflection
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, contemporary impasto oil portrait based strictly on the provided reference image. Face + identity must match the reference correctly — preserve precise bone structure, eye shape, nose proportions, lip shape/fullness, jawline, cheekbone structure, facial symmetry, skin tone, and overall likeness.

Pose & Framing
Head Pose: Perfectly front-facing, upright head position with no tilt or rotation. Chin level and centered. The face is aligned vertically with the frame’s center axis. Direct, steady eye contact with the viewer. Expression calm and neutral.
Neck & Body Pose: Visible neck fully exposed. Shoulders relaxed and naturally dropped. Upper squared to camera. No dramatic twist. Body posture elegant and elongated, creating a vertical flow from chest to crown.
Framing: Tight vertical close-up portrait. Cropped just below the upper shoulder area and slightly above the top of the hair. Head occupies majority of the frame height. Symmetrical centered composition with equal negative space on both sides. Minimal background dominance — subject clearly foregrounded.
Camera Angle: Strict eye-level, classic studio portrait alignment. No distortion, no low/high angle exaggeration.
Focal Priority: Maximum sharpness and detail around eyes, nose bridge, and lips; painterly falloff toward outer hair edges and lower neck.
Artistic Style & Technique
Paint in bold contemporary impasto style with thick, sculptural paint application. Use heavy palette-knife marks and wide stiff-brush strokes. Keep strokes broken and gestural (no smooth airbrushed blending). The paint surface must look physically layered and 3D.
Add thick raised “dollops” of white/cream paint on the forehead (central upper area), cheeks, nose bridge, and chin so highlights appear tactile and catch light naturally.
Color Palette & Lighting
Background: cool muted teal / seafoam backdrop with subtle tonal variation and visible brush texture.
Skin tones: complex mosaic of earthy tones — burnt sienna, ochre, coral, rose pink, warm beige — plus small accents of soft yellow and hints of cool sky-blue undertones.
Hair: deep brown rendered with broad sweeping strokes, slightly loose and imperfect. Add bold flashes of cadmium yellow and bright white near the upper sections to suggest reflected light and artistic accent strokes.
Lighting direction: from the upper-left. Strong impasto highlights on left forehead, cheekbone, nose bridge, and upper lip. Softer warm shadows on the right side of the face.
Subject Expression & Features
Neutral yet intense expression. Lips softly parted with natural fullness. Calm, poised, introspective mood.
Eyes are the sharpest area: piercing seafoam green/blue with crisp white catchlights; high realism even within painterly texture.
Edge Work & Integration
Let edges of hair and shoulders softly bleed into the background using thin, wispy strokes so the subject blends naturally into the teal space rather than appearing cut-out. Maintain visible canvas grain and authentic oil paint thickness throughout.
Output: 1:1 aspect ratio, ultra-detailed, gallery-quality oil painting look, photographed in studio light, 8K resolution, sharp texture, rich impasto depth.
